title: Do I need the (Blender/Godot) MCPs
author: ookayokay
selftext:
Hi,

Newbie here. I am developing a Godot game with help of Claude code and using Blender to create some models for it. So far CC is handling everything via CLI commands and tells me it does not need MCPs for these tasks. It seems to do a good job but since I am a newbie, I may misjudge. So far I ask it to come up with some model ideas and I choose between them, or tell it how the game should work and it applies those changes. 

Do I need the MCPs for these tools, what would be the advantage? 

Thanks in advance
